title: YOUR TEAMMATE SHOWS BARE HANDS WHEN HIS HANDS ARE BUSY
why: In your own window your character puts the gun away while a grenade or a heal is out, while searching or cutting a seal, and on Bare Hands (v26.29, v7.61), but the state word sent to the teammate carried only the gun, so the other window kept drawing him holding his gun (and on Bare Hands drew a default long gun shape). Proven in a staged pair in one window, both ways: with a frag out, searching, or on Bare Hands the host was drawn in player 2 window with mode '' (gun out) instead of 'none', and the same for player 2 seen by the host and passed on to a third window. Now the state word carries one more flag, hd, for busy hands, the host passes it on, and the teammate is drawn with bare hands exactly when he sees himself that way. A word without the flag (an older window) reads as empty hands, as before.
now: In co-op, a teammate with a grenade or heal out, searching, cutting a seal or on Bare Hands now shows bare hands in your window, just as he sees himself.
